clue.text: Tony's unfinished birdsong?

indicators.note: unfinished means the last letter of the song is cut off

parts.note: a song sung by a bird, here a red-breasted one: the bird's name followed by SONG

explanation.surface: A man named Tony leaves a bird's tune incomplete.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfinished' drops the final G. Tony Robinson is a British actor and TV presenter, best known as Baldrick in Blackadder.
explanation.definitionFit: Surname of the British actor and broadcaster Tony, famous for playing Baldrick and presenting Time Team.

clue.text: Top knight run down

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for knight
run down means unwell, poorly

explanation.surface: A senior knight is worn out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Top' looks like an adjective for the knight, but it is a slang verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang synonym: to top someone is to finish them off.

clue.text: Sheriff of a US state wearing linen

indicators.note: wearing means the fabric is put on around the state, enclosing it

parts.note: lawn is a fine linen fabric
MA is the postal abbreviation for Massachusetts

explanation.surface: A sheriff from somewhere in America is dressed in linen.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheriff is a law officer, the Wild West's term for such an enforcer.

clue.text: Room taken by American correspondent with Cicero

indicators.note: taken by means the room is followed by the American piece in a chain

parts.note: an attic is a room under the roof
US means American

explanation.surface: A room is rented to an American who exchanges letters with Cicero.
explanation.walkthrough: Titus Pomponius Atticus was the Roman friend to whom Cicero wrote a famous series of letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Historical example: the Roman to whom Cicero addressed his letters Ad Atticum.

clue.text: Out for a cut

indicators.note: out means the letters of the next words are put out of order

explanation.surface: Someone is going out to get a haircut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Out' looks like going out, but it signals rearranging FORA.
explanation.definitionFit: A haircut style: a rounded, bushy hairstyle is a kind of cut.

clue.text: You'd be done for, being laid out by such a professional

definitions.text: You'd be done for, being laid out by such a professional

parts.words: You'd be done for, being laid out by such a professional
parts.note: being done for and laid out sound like defeat in a fight, but they describe a dead body prepared by the person who arranges funerals

explanation.surface: A warning that a tough professional fighter would knock you flat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Done for' and 'laid out' read as a beating; in fact you are dead and your body is laid out for burial.
explanation.definitionFit: A funeral director is the professional who lays out the dead before burial.

clue.text: Got the shakes? Here's a quarter

indicators.note: the shakes means the words before are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone trembling is told this is a district of the city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shakes' rearranges GOTTHE.
explanation.definitionFit: A city district where a minority lives segregated is a quarter of the town.

clue.text: Refrain from taking out main ruling

indicators.note: taking means the word for refrain holds the next part inside it

parts.note: to refrain is to say 'don't' to yourself

indicators.note: out means the letters of main are put out of order

explanation.surface: Someone avoids removing the chief rule.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Refrain' reads as a verb but stands for the contraction of do not; 'out' scrambles the next word into MINA, and 'taking' puts that inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the ruling or dominant party is the one in control.

clue.text: Bird following edge

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for following, as in page references
to edge forward is to inch along

explanation.surface: A bird trails along behind a border.
explanation.walkthrough: 'edge' looks like a noun but is the verb, to creep slowly.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a small seed-eating songbird such as the chaffinch.

clue.text: See 26
Fancy items on tea house

indicators.note: fancy means the letters are arranged in an elaborate new way

explanation.surface: Decorative objects set out at a tea party in someone's home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fancy' rearranges ITEMSONTEA.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat on two floors with its own entrance is a kind of dwelling, a house in the broad sense.

clue.text: A major's free to go after crossword setters!

indicators.note: to go after means the free part is placed following the setters

parts.note: the setter refers to themselves and colleagues as us
free means open, unrestricted

explanation.surface: An army major is released and pursues the people who set crosswords.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A major' is not an officer but one of golf's four major championships, played in America.
explanation.definitionFit: The American tennis or golf championship is one of the sport's major tournaments.

clue.text: Masculine person of courage following fairy's orbital point

indicators.note: following means the masculine and courageous pieces come after the fairy

parts.note: a peri is a fairy in Persian mythology
he is the masculine pronoun
a brave person is called a lion

explanation.surface: A brave man pursues a fairy around her orbit.
explanation.definitionFit: Astronomy term: the place in a planet's orbit nearest the sun.

clue.text: Loosen up large body, only to gain weight

indicators.note: to gain means the weight is added on at the end

parts.note: the UN, the United Nations, is a large international body
but means only, as in 'but a child'
a ton is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: Advice to a big body to relax its clothing, only to put on more pounds.
explanation.definitionFit: To undo the buttons of a garment is to loosen it up.

clue.text: Report male going to express disapproval

indicators.note: going means the male letter departs from the word

parts.note: a report is a loud bang, a boom

explanation.surface: An informant tells of a man leaving, prompting disapproval.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Report' is a bang, not an account: BOOM loses M.
explanation.definitionFit: To jeer at a performer by calling out is to express disapproval.

clue.text: One who doesn't appreciate where a fire might be started

definitions.meaning: an ungrateful person, who fails to value kindness

definitions.text: where a fire might be started
definitions.meaning: read as two words, inside a fireplace's iron basket, where a hearth fire is lit

explanation.surface: An ungrateful person shown the spot to light a fire.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as IN GRATE, the second reading is a location.
explanation.definitionFit: An ungrateful person fails to show thanks for what is done for them.

clue.text: Large bell or half of a drum?

definitions.meaning: Great ... is the big bell of Christ Church, Oxford, and the name is used for large bells generally
the ...-... drum's name is a doubled word, so one half is the first three letters

explanation.surface: Asking whether a big bell is really half a drum.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep-toned bell is often given this name, and the doubled-name drum gives it again.

clue.text: Derisory marriage of convenience initially imposed on ruler

indicators.note: imposed on means the initials are placed before the ruler
initially means take the first letter of each of the three words before

parts.note: a king is a ruler

explanation.surface: A sham marriage is forced on a monarch, which is laughable.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: derisory remarks are scornful, ridiculing ones.

clue.text: Term not used before, includes Latin America (formerly)

indicators.note: includes means the new term holds the Latin abbreviation inside

parts.note: a neologism, a new word

explanation.surface: A fresh term covering Latin America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Latin America' looks like one unit; Latin gives L and America is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Historical name: the Americas were once called this by Europeans, as opposed to the Old World.

clue.text: Spot a personal problem that makes you feel better in your head

definitions.text: that makes you feel better in your head

parts.note: a spot is a place
BO, body odour, is a personal hygiene problem

explanation.surface: Identifying a private problem that a cure only seems to fix.
explanation.walkthrough: BO is body odour.
explanation.definitionFit: A dummy pill works only through the patient's belief, so improvement is in the mind.

clue.text: Drunken celeb about to act badly — sauce!

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters go round the overacting piece
drunken means the letters of celeb reel about into a new order

parts.note: to ham is to overact

explanation.surface: A drunk celebrity is about to misbehave, the cheek of it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drunken' rearranges CELEB to BECEL, which goes 'about' HAM. 'sauce!' looks like an exclamation of cheek but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the white roux-based sauce of French cooking.

clue.text: Run out of circuits to go in opposite ends of electronic device

indicators.note: to go in means the circuits are placed between the two end letters
the opposite ends of the phrase electronic device are its first and last letters

parts.note: circuits of a track are laps

explanation.surface: A gadget's battery runs down after too many circuits.
explanation.definitionFit: When time runs out it passes and expires, as a lease or deadline does.

clue.text: Unreadable stuff from singular creep

parts.note: S is the grammar abbreviation for singular
to creep is to crawl

explanation.surface: Illegible material produced by an odd sycophant.
explanation.definitionFit: Messy, illegible handwriting is hard to read.

clue.text: Arm support, possibly made from special fabric

parts.note: lint is a soft fabric used for dressing wounds

explanation.surface: A sling or brace made out of a particular material.
explanation.definitionFit: A rigid strip strapped to a broken limb is one example of a brace for an arm.

clue.text: Polish and protect car Lily pranged — show enthusiasm!

parts.note: waxing a car polishes and protects its paintwork

indicators.note: pranged, crashed, means the letters are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: Instructions to polish a car that Lily crashed, with gusto.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pranged' (British slang for crashed) rearranges CARLILY.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to talk effusively and enthusiastically about something.

clue.text: It's very expensive to get legal papers heard

indicators.note: heard means the word for the legal papers is spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: writs are formal legal documents

explanation.surface: Getting legal documents served costs a fortune.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ritz is a famously luxurious London hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: The luxury hotel's name stands for opulence, as in 'putting on the Ritz'.

clue.text: Salvation Army man, unwell, is for the cemetery

parts.note: William Booth founded the Salvation Army
unwell means ill

explanation.surface: A sick Salvation Army officer is headed for the graveyard.
explanation.walkthrough: William Booth founded the Salvation Army; the answer is split over two lights, the first word four letters long.
explanation.definitionFit: Name for a Wild West burial ground for gunfighters who died with their boots on.

clue.text: Swift's time?

definitions.meaning: a swift is a fast-flying migrant species
British slang: time spent in prison

explanation.surface: Asking about the time of Jonathan Swift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swift' looks like the author; in prison slang, bird is a jail sentence.
explanation.definitionFit: A swift is a feathered creature, and a prison sentence is called by the same word.

clue.text: Pack content cut, so destabilised

indicators.note: destabilised means the letters are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: A happy group cut back and thrown off balance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pack content' looks like a satisfied crowd; it is a member of a Scout pack. 'destabilised' rearranges CUTSO.
explanation.definitionFit: A pack of young Cubs and Scouts contains such members.

clue.text: Aircraft tilt and turn support

parts.note: an aircraft banks when it tilts to turn
to roll is to turn over

explanation.surface: A plane tilts and turns, a flying manoeuvre.
explanation.definitionFit: To bankroll a venture is to fund and back it financially.
